name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-10-07, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
